description: This Java class defines a custom exception LookupTableNotFoundException for handling cases where a lookup table is not found. It extends an abstract exception class and provides a constructor that includes an error message with a specific key.

classes.name: LookupTableNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a lookup table with a specific ID was not found in the system.
